notes.title: Frontline: New Revolution | The Great Update!
notes.content:
[previewyoutube=RqMAUnCtye8;full][/previewyoutube]

Coming soon, a series of exciting new features will be arriving! We'll have fully updated systems, a completely revamped HUD, the beginning of a new storyline, brand new fully functional abilities, innovative dialogues, new maps, and much more. And believe us, this is just the beginning of everything we have in store! We are thrilled to announce that the game will soon have seasons and an exciting Battle Pass, so you can enjoy 100% of the experience that Wise Labs aims to bring!

Live the style to the fullest with the Conquest Battle Pass. Take on daily and weekly challenges to earn exclusive themed rewards, such as legendary skins for Phaser, Razr, and Angel, absolutely epic sets for Castle, Shifter, and Minerva, reactive skins for various weapons, and much more! Get the Conquest Battle Pass now or opt for the bundle to instantly unlock the first 25 levels.

I might be biased, but... it's simply incredible!

/Wise Labs
